name: doomsday dreamgirl
source:
You're left staring at a stranger whom you've invited into the safety of your home for the final countdown. Is the end of the world even worth crying about? Surely not? But her tears keep telling you otherwise.

[Edited from [url=https://nadianova.itch.io/doomsday-dreamgirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你望着眼前的陌生女孩。为了共同等待最后的倒计时，你将她请进了安全的家中。世界末日真的值得为之哭泣吗？应该不至于吧？可她的泪水，却不断告诉你另一个答案。

[整理自[url=https://nadianova.itch.io/doomsday-dreamgirl]itch.io[/url]]
